groups.name: io
groups.why: the target headers (JTAG, UART, SPI, CORTEX, LA, I2C) and the voltage and mode switches; all locked at the board edge

groups.name: usb_in
groups.why: the USB-C receptacle with its CC pull-downs (R1, R2) and the shield RC (R3, C25)

groups.name: power
groups.why: the two AP7365 LDOs (1V8 and 3V3) fed from +5V through the VBUS ferrite FB3, their input caps (C1, C3, C26) and output caps (C2, C4), and the GND test point

groups.name: core
groups.why: the FT2232HQ with its VREG and +3V3 decaps, the VPHY and VPLL ferrite filters, the REF resistor and pull-ups, and the 93LC46 EEPROM with its pull-ups

groups.name: clock
groups.why: the 12 MHz crystal and its load caps

groups.name: shift_a
groups.why: level shifter U5 (SN74LVC8T245) with its pull and series networks; anchored on J2, the header it drives most

groups.name: shift_b
groups.why: level shifter U6 (SN74LVC8T245) with its pull and series networks

groups.name: vref
groups.why: the target reference voltage: its sense FET and LED (Q1, D2, R5), its divider and pull-down, its decaps, the ISO jumper and the SPI pull-ups

groups.name: ui
groups.why: the power, RX, TX and enable LEDs with their resistors
